simple.prompt: When I was in university, I ___ play basketball every Saturday morning.
simple.explanation: 'Used to + V1' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan atau rutinitas masa lalu yang sudah tidak dilakukan lagi saat ini.
hints: Kebiasaan rutin masa lalu yang sudah berhenti.
Gunakan 'used to'.

simple.prompt: She ___ live in a rural village before relocating to the metropolis.
simple.explanation: Untuk menyatakan STATUS atau KEADAAN masa lalu (past state/stative verb seperti live, have, be, know), HANYA 'used to' yang bisa digunakan ('used to live'). 'Would' tidak bisa untuk stative verbs.
hints: 'Live' adalah past state (keadaan menetap).
'Would' tidak boleh digunakan untuk past state.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Habit dengan 'used to'.
simple.targetSentence: We used to walk to school together.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + used to + base verb (walk) + to school together.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We used to'.
Verb dasar adalah 'walk to school together'.

simple.prompt: Negative form: In the past, people ___ rely so heavily on automated digital assistants.
simple.explanation: Bentuk negatif baku dengan auxiliary 'didn't': 'didn't use to' (tanpa huruf -d pada use).
hints: Setelah auxiliary 'didn't', gunakan bentuk dasar 'use to'.
Bentuk baku: 'didn't use to'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya 'Did you use to'.
simple.targetSentence: Did you use to play any musical instruments?
simple.explanation: Did you use to + base verb (play) + any musical instruments?
hints: Awali pertanyaan dengan 'Did you use to'.
Verb dasar: 'play any musical instruments'.

simple.prompt: He ___ have long hair during his adolescent years.
simple.explanation: 'Have' (memiliki/berambut) menyatakan keadaan (state), sehingga wajib menggunakan 'used to have'.
hints: 'Have' di sini adalah kata kerja keadaan.
Gunakan 'used to'.

simple.targetSentence: Every summer we would visit our grandparents.
simple.explanation: Subject + would + base verb (visit) untuk kebiasaan aksi berulang bernuansa nostalgia di masa lalu.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Every summer'.
Gunakan 'we would visit our grandparents'.

simple.prompt: Before the metro line opened, Maya ___ take two crowded buses to work every day.
simple.explanation: Kebiasaan rutin masa lampau yang kini tidak lagi dilakukan dinyatakan dengan 'used to + V1' (perhatikan akhiran '-d' pada kalimat positif).
hints: Kalimat positif tentang rutinitas masa lalu yang sudah berhenti.
Bentuk bakunya 'used to' (memakai -d).

simple.prompt: Did your grandfather ___ own a small watch repair shop near the harbor?
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya berawalan 'Did' (atau negatif 'didn't'), akhiran '-d' dilepas menjadi 'use to'.
hints: Sudah ada auxiliary lampau 'Did' di depan.
Setelah 'Did', hilangkan '-d' → 'use to'.

simple.prompt: Our town ___ have a tram network in the 1960s, though the tracks were removed later.
simple.explanation: 'Have' di sini menyatakan KEADAAN (state) di masa lalu ('dulu memiliki'), bukan aksi berulang; hanya 'used to' yang boleh dipakai untuk past states, bukan 'would'.
hints: Apakah 'own/have' itu tindakan aksi berulang atau keadaan?
'Would' tidak boleh untuk keadaan statis lampau; pakai 'used to'.

simple.prompt: We ___ live near the noisy ring road, so we really enjoy our quiet neighborhood now.
simple.explanation: Kalimat negatif masa lalu memakai 'didn't use to' (atau 'used not to' sangat formal), tanpa '-d' setelah 'didn't'.
hints: Perhatikan auxiliary negatif 'didn't'.
Setelah 'didn't', gunakan bentuk dasar 'use to'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang adaptasi rutinitas baru dengan 'be used to'.
dialogue: Colleague
Isn't waking up at five for the morning shift exhausting?
Nurse
It was hard at first, yet now I am ___ early hours.
simple.explanation: 'Be used to + noun / V-ing' bermakna 'sudah terbiasa dengan'; kata 'to' adalah preposisi sehingga diikuti V-ing ('working').
hints: Terdapat to be 'am' tepat sebelum rumpang.
Pola 'am used to + V-ing' berarti terbiasa.

simple.prompt: Back in college, my friends and I ___ often stay up until midnight debating design ideas.
simple.explanation: Kebiasaan aksi yang sering diulang di masa lalu ('stay up... debating') juga dapat diceritakan dengan 'would + V1' (note: 'used' tanpa 'to' salah).
hints: 'Stay up' adalah aksi berulang dengan penanda waktu 'Back in college'.
Opsi yang benar-benar lengkap secara struktur adalah 'would'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda menyertakan '-d' sesudah 'didn't' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Small neighborhood cafés didn't used to offer contactless QR payments ten years ago.
options: Small neighborhood cafés didn't use to offer contactless QR payments ten years ago.
Small neighborhood cafés wouldn't use to offer contactless QR payments ten years ago.
Small neighborhood cafés didn't using to offer contactless QR payments ten years ago.
simple.explanation: Sesudah 'didn't', verb kembali ke bentuk dasar tanpa -d: 'didn't use to offer'.
hints: Cek kata bantu lampau 'didn't'.
Hapus huruf -d pada 'used' setelah 'didn't'.

simple.prompt: After moving to Tokyo, it took Farhan two months to ___ riding packed commuter trains.
simple.explanation: Proses menjadi terbiasa ('lama-kelamaan terbiasa') dinyatakan dengan 'get used to + V-ing / noun'.
hints: Menekankan proses adaptasi ('it took two months to...').
Proses membiasakan diri memakai 'get used to'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kebiasaan lampau menggunakan 'used to'.
simple.targetSentence: I used to print every draft until our office went paperless.
simple.explanation: Subject + used to + V1 ('print') + object + time clause.
hints: Awali dengan 'I used to print every draft'.
Akhiri dengan 'until our office went paperless'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesuaian kebiasaan menggunakan 'get used to + V-ing'.
simple.targetSentence: New interns quickly get used to logging their hours daily.
simple.explanation: 'Get used to' diikuti gerund ('logging') untuk menunjukkan proses menjadi terbiasa.
hints: Mulai dengan 'New interns quickly get used to'.
Tambahkan gerund 'logging their hours daily'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog yang membedakan 'used to' (aksi/status) vs 'would' (hanya aksi berulang).
dialogue: Grandparent
When we were children, there ___ be an old steam train station down by the river.
Grandchild
And how did you travel to the village?
Grandparent
We ___ walk along the tracks every Sunday.
intermediate.explanation: Bagian pertama adalah keberadaan/keadaan fisik ('there used to be' - tidak bisa dengan would). Bagian kedua adalah aksi aktif berulang ('we would walk').
hints: Ada to be 'be' (keadaan) $\rightarrow$ used to.
Aksi aktif berulang $\rightarrow$ would.

intermediate.prompt: Whenever it rained on weekends, my father ___ bake fresh sourdough bread for the family.
intermediate.explanation: 'Would + base verb' sangat sering digunakan untuk aksi rutin masa lalu yang terjadi berulang setiap kali ada pemicu ('Whenever it rained... my father would bake').
hints: Aksi berulang setiap kali kondisi tertentu terjadi.
Gunakan modal 'would'.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast with 'be used to': 'She has lived in London for five years, so she ___ the rainy climate.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Be used to + noun' berarti sudah terbiasa dengan suatu kondisi (accustomed to).
hints: Bermakna 'sudah terbiasa'.
Gunakan 'is used to'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat proses pembiasaan dengan 'get used to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: You will soon get used to the fast pace of the city.
intermediate.explanation: 'Get used to' berarti mengalami proses menjadi terbiasa (becoming accustomed to).
hints: Mulai dengan 'You will soon get used to'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'the fast pace of the city'.

intermediate.prompt: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT?
options: My family would own a small cottage near the lake. (Incorrect: 'own' is a stative verb)
My family used to own a small cottage near the lake. (Correct)
My family would spend every summer at the lake. (Correct: action verb)
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' (memiliki) adalah stative verb (kata kerja keadaan). 'Would' TIDAK BISA digunakan dengan stative verbs. Kalimat tersebut salah dan harus memakai 'used to own'.
hints: 'Own' adalah stative verb.
'Would' tidak boleh dipasangkan dengan stative verb.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat perbandingan masa lalu dan masa kini.
intermediate.targetSentence: I used to drink soda but now I drink water.
intermediate.explanation: I used to drink soda (masa lalu) + but now I drink water (kontras masa kini).
hints: Kebiasaan lama: 'I used to drink soda'.
Kontras saat ini: 'but now I drink water'.

dialogue: Old Friend
Do you recall our university days in Edinburgh?
Alumnus
Yes, we ___ sit in the student cafeteria for hours debating philosophy.
intermediate.explanation: Mengisahkan kenangan manis aksi berulang masa lalu menggunakan 'would sit'.
hints: Nostalgia aksi berulang masa lalu.
Gunakan 'would sit'.

intermediate.prompt: Which sentence is INCORRECT because 'would' cannot describe a past state?
options: There would be a huge pine tree behind the primary school.
Every July, my grandmother would bake pineapple tarts.
We would sit on the porch watching evening ferries pass by.
intermediate.explanation: Keberadaan atau keadaan statis masa lampau ('There used to be a huge pine tree...') TIDAK boleh memakai 'would'; 'would' hanya untuk aksi berulang berpola waktu tertentu.
hints: Cari kalimat yang menyatakan keberadaan/keadaan tetap ('be'), bukan aksi berulang.
'There would be' tidak bisa menggantikan 'There used to be'.

intermediate.prompt: Look closely: 'She ___ to live in Bandung' vs 'She ___ living in cool mountain air.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Used to + V1 (live)' menyatakan masa lalu yang sudah berhenti; 'is used to + V-ing (living)' menyatakan sudah terbiasa sekarang.
hints: Klausa pertama memakai V1 'live'.
Klausa kedua memakai V-ing 'living'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan yang membedakan kebiasaan ('used to') vs satu kejadian tunggal masa lalu (Past Simple).
dialogue: Interviewer
Did you use to travel abroad every month in your old job?
Applicant
Not every month — actually, I ___ to Manila just once for a trade show.
intermediate.explanation: 'Used to' dan 'would' HANYA untuk kebiasaan berulang atau keadaan lama; kejadian yang terjadi TEPAT SATU KALI ('just once') wajib menggunakan Past Simple ('flew').
hints: Kata kunci: 'just once' (hanya sekali).
Kejadian tunggal lampau tidak memakai 'used to' maupun 'would'.

intermediate.prompt: Don't worry if the new keyboard layout feels awkward today — you ___ it within a week.
intermediate.explanation: Memprediksi bahwa seseorang akan menjadi terbiasa di masa depan memakai 'will get used to + noun/pronoun'.
hints: Menunjukkan proses adaptasi dalam waktu seminggu ke depan.
Gunakan 'will get used to'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice how 'would' needs an established past time frame: '___, my uncle would repair broken radios on the back porch.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Would' untuk kebiasaan nostalgia tidak boleh berdiri tanpa konteks waktu lampau berulang; frasa 'During rainy weekends' memberi bingkai waktu lampau berulang yang alami.
hints: 'Would' kebiasaan wajib memiliki konteks masa lampau berulang.
Pilih frasa yang menandai momen berulang masa lalu ('During rainy weekends').

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan 'be used to' dengan bare infinitive berikut.
intermediate.draft: Because I grew up in a noisy port city, I am completely used to sleep through ferry horns.
options: Because I grew up in a noisy port city, I am completely used to sleeping through ferry horns.
Because I grew up in a noisy port city, I completely used to sleep through ferry horns.
Because I grew up in a noisy port city, I am completely used to slept through ferry horns.
intermediate.explanation: Karena ada to be 'am' di depan, frasa 'am used to' bermakna 'sudah terbiasa' dan mewajibkan gerund ('sleeping'), bukan V1 'sleep'.
hints: Perhatikan to be 'am' sebelum 'completely used to'.
Pola 'be used to + V-ing'.

intermediate.prompt: Did you ___ enjoy long bus rides, or did they always make you carsick?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan Past Simple dengan 'Did you...' menanyakan kesukaan masa lampau memakai bentuk tanpa '-d': 'use to enjoy' (bukan 'be used to' karena verb setelahnya V1 'enjoy').
hints: Lihat V1 'enjoy' dan auxiliary 'Did' di awal kalimat.
Kombinasinya adalah 'Did you use to + V1'.

intermediate.prompt: Before selling their shop in 2010, our parents ___ a tiny corner bakery for five years.
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' adalah stative verb kepemilikan di masa lampau ('dulu memiliki'), sehingga wajib memakai 'used to own' (atau Past Simple 'owned'), bukan 'would own'.
hints: Kepemilikan adalah state (keadaan), bukan aksi berulang.
Gunakan 'used to own'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai 'used to' yang kontras dengan kondisi sekarang.
intermediate.targetSentence: Riko used to hate public speaking, but now he hosts weekly webinars.
intermediate.explanation: 'Used to hate' menyatakan sikap/perasaan masa lalu yang sudah berubah kini.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Riko used to hate public speaking,'.
Kontraskan dengan 'but now he hosts weekly webinars'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pertanyaan negatif masa lalu dengan 'didn't ... use to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Didn't this historic avenue use to have shaded tram tracks?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan negatif memakai 'Didn't + Subject + use to + V1...?'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Didn't this historic avenue'.
Lengkapi 'use to have shaded tram tracks?'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kerancuan gramatikal antara 'used to + V1' dan 'be used to + V-ing'.
complex.draft: I am used to wake up at 5:00 a.m. when I was in military service.
options: I used to wake up at 5:00 a.m. when I was in military service.
I was used to wake up at 5:00 a.m. when I was in military service.
I used to waking up at 5:00 a.m. when I was in military service.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan kebiasaan lampau yang sudah usai di masa dinas militer, gunakan 'used to + base verb': 'I used to wake up'.
hints: Menceritakan kebiasaan masa dinas militer lampau.
Gunakan bentuk dasar 'used to wake up'.

complex.prompt: Notice the difference with past habit vs single occurrence: 'Last Friday, our team ___ the sprint demo.'
complex.explanation: Untuk satu peristiwa tunggal yang terjadi pada satu waktu tertentu ('Last Friday'), TIDAK BISA menggunakan 'used to' atau 'would'. Wajib menggunakan Past Simple murni: 'conducted'.
hints: Peristiwa tunggal satu kali terjadi pada hari Jumat lalu.
Pantang menggunakan used to/would untuk single past event.

complex.prompt: Stylistic variety in narrative prose: In literature, authors often introduce a past topic with 'used to', and then continue with '___' for vivid recurring scenes.
complex.explanation: Dalam prosa naratif sastra, penulis biasanya membuka paragraf dengan 'used to' untuk menetapkan konteks masa lalu, lalu merinci kenangan aksi berulang berikutnya menggunakan 'would'.
hints: Pola variasi gaya sastra naratif.
Gunakan 'would' untuk detail kenangan aksi berulang.

complex.targetSentence: Every evening the old fisherman would mend his nets.
complex.explanation: Every evening (frekuensi) + subject + would mend (kebiasaan) + his nets.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Every evening'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'the old fisherman would mend his nets'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan gerund setelah 'get used to'.
complex.draft: It took several months for the foreign executive to get used to lead meetings in English.
options: It took several months for the foreign executive to get used to leading meetings in English.
It took several months for the foreign executive to used to lead meetings in English.
It took several months for the foreign executive to be used to lead meetings in English.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'get used to', partikel 'to' adalah preposisi, sehingga WAJIB diikuti Gerund (-ing): 'get used to leading meetings'.
hints: 'Get used to' wajib diikuti oleh gerund (-ing).
Gunakan 'get used to leading'.

complex.prompt: Stative verb of emotion: 'She ___ believe in horoscopes when she was an adolescent.'
complex.explanation: 'Believe' adalah stative verb of cognition (kata kerja keyakinan batin), sehingga tidak boleh menggunakan 'would'. Wajib: 'used to believe'.
hints: 'Believe' adalah kata kerja keyakinan mental (stative).
Gunakan 'used to', bukan 'would'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis sejarah perkembangan kota.
dialogue: Historian
How did the citizens cross the river prior to the 1920 bridge?
Local Guide
A wooden ferry boat ___ operate back and forth every hour.
complex.explanation: Operate dalam konteks keberadaan layanan transportasi rutin masa lalu menggunakan 'used to operate'.
hints: Layanan transportasi rutin masa lalu yang sudah tidak ada.
Gunakan 'used to operate'.

complex.prompt: Choose the sentence that accurately respects ALL rules of 'would' vs 'used to' in literary narrative.
options: Every autumn, grandfather would gather fallen leaves, though the orchard used to belong to the neighboring monastery.
Every autumn, grandfather would gather fallen leaves, and the orchard would belong to the neighboring monastery.
Grandfather would once lived in that monastery for ten years.
complex.explanation: Aksi berulang bernuansa nostalgia ('would gather') dipadukan secara elegan dengan fakta keadaan statis kepemilikan ('used to belong'); pada opsi lain, 'would belong' (stative verb) dan 'would once lived' salah.
hints: Ingat: 'belong' adalah stative verb sehingga tidak boleh memakai 'would'.
Pastikan aksi berulang vs keadaan tetap ditempatkan tepat.

complex.prompt: Why is 'I can't get used to the team changing deadlines every Friday' grammatical?
options: 'The team' acts as the logical subject before the gerund 'changing' after preposition 'to'
'Get used to' always takes bare infinitive 'changing'
'Used to' replaces Present Perfect Continuous here
complex.explanation: Setelah 'get used to' (preposisi 'to'), frasa 'the team changing deadlines' adalah gerund clause dengan subjeknya sendiri ('the team'), yang secara tata bahasa berfungsi sebagai objek preposisi 'to'.
hints: 'To' pada 'get used to' adalah preposisi yang diikuti gerund clause.
Lihat peran 'the team changing...' sebagai gerund ber-subjek.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan 'used to' untuk durasi yang diukur pasti (bukan kebiasaan tak tentu) berikut.
complex.draft: Last year, I used to visit Singapore exactly three times for client audits.
options: Last year, I visited Singapore exactly three times for client audits.
Last year, I would visit Singapore exactly three times for client audits.
Last year, I had used to visit Singapore exactly three times for client audits.
complex.explanation: Apabila jumlah kejadian sudah dihitung persis dalam periode spesifik ('Last year ... exactly three times'), JANGAN menggunakan 'used to' maupun 'would'; gunakan Past Simple ('visited').
hints: Penghitungan jumlah kali yang eksak ('exactly three times') wajib memakai Past Simple.
Hapus 'used to' dan gunakan V2 'visited'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi tata bahasa tingkat lanjut tentang kata kerja pasif 'be used to' (= dipakai untuk) vs 'be used to' (= terbiasa).
dialogue: Student
In 'This laser is used to measure microscopic cracks', why is 'measure' NOT 'measuring'?
Tutor
Because here 'is used' is simply the passive voice of the verb 'use' (= dipakai untuk), followed by ___!
complex.explanation: Bedakan dua struktur identik permukaan ini: 1) 'is used to + V-ing' (= terbiasa); 2) 'is used (passive of use) + to V1' (= digunakan untuk melakukan tujuan tertentu, seperti laser digunakan untuk mengukur).
hints: 'Is used' di sini adalah pasif dari kata kerja 'use' (dipakai).
'To measure' berfungsi sebagai infinitive tujuan (in order to measure).

complex.prompt: Notice the stylistic nuance: in formal narrative prose, writers avoid repeating 'used to' six times in one paragraph by switching to ___ for repeated past actions.
complex.explanation: Praktik gaya bahasa naratif baku: perkenalkan bingkai waktu lampau pertama kali dengan 'used to' atau Past Simple, lalu lanjutkan rangkaian kebiasaan aksinya dengan 'would + V1' agar mengalir halus.
hints: Dalam narasi, setelah latar lampau dibangun, aksi berulang dilanjutkan dengan modal naratif.
Pilih 'would + bare infinitive'.

complex.prompt: Although the night-shift nurses ___ sleeping during daylight now, new trainees still struggle with the schedule.
complex.explanation: Menekankan bahwa perawat telah melewati proses adaptasi hingga kini sudah terbiasa memakai Present Perfect dari 'get used to': 'have gotten/got used to + V-ing'.
hints: Subjek jamak 'nurses' + V-ing 'sleeping'.
Gunakan Present Perfect 'have gotten used to'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyalahgunakan 'would' pada stative verb mental ('believe') berikut.
complex.draft: During the nineteenth century, many physicians would believe that sea fog caused malaria.
options: During the nineteenth century, many physicians used to believe that sea fog caused malaria.
During the nineteenth century, many physicians were used to believe that sea fog caused malaria.
During the nineteenth century, many physicians would believed that sea fog caused malaria.
complex.explanation: 'Believe' adalah kata kerja keadaan mental (stative verb), sehingga tidak boleh memakai 'would' untuk keyakinan lama; gunakan 'used to believe' (atau Past Simple 'believed').
hints: 'Believe' menyatakan keadaan keyakinan, bukan aksi fisik berulang.
Ganti 'would believe' menjadi 'used to believe'.

complex.prompt: In very formal British style, the negative of 'used to' without 'did' appears as '___' (rare in everyday speech).
complex.explanation: Di luar bentuk modern 'didn't use to', penulisan sastra/formal tradisional kadang memakai 'used not to + V1'.
hints: Bentuk formal tanpa 'did' menempatkan 'not' di antara 'used' dan 'to'.
Pilih 'used not to'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat kontras makna pasif 'be used to + V1' (digunakan untuk) dengan rapi.
complex.targetSentence: This high-frequency probe is used to detect hairline cracks inside turbine blades.
complex.explanation: 'Is used' (pasif dari 'use') diikuti infinitive tujuan 'to detect', bukan gerund.
hints: Awali dengan 'This high-frequency probe is used to detect'.
Tambahkan objek dan lokasi.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat narasi nostalgia yang memadukan konteks pembuka dan kebiasaan 'would'.
complex.targetSentence: Back in my village, neighbors would gather under the banyan tree every dusk.
complex.explanation: Setelah bingkai lampau 'Back in my village', aksi kebiasaan berulang diungkapkan memakai 'would gather'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Back in my village, neighbors would gather'.
Tambahkan tempat dan waktu berulang.
